criteria.evidence: pr-review.yml: `on: pull_request: types: [opened, ready_for_review]` plus workflow_dispatch.
Prompt: "Delegate the review itself to the `pr-reviewer` subagent defined in `.claude/agents/pr-reviewer.md`" with Task in --allowedTools.
Separate `Post review` step runs `gh pr comment "$PR" --body-file "$review"` and fails if the review file is empty.
Turn 1: per-review ~$1.50–3 Opus / ~$0.75–1.50 Sonnet, ~$30–60/mo at 20 PRs, from bundled pricing reference with network block disclosed.
Turn 1 'Versus the subscription path': claude_code_oauth_token bills against Pro/Max quota, shared with interactive usage, limits unverified.
Turn 3: `gh secret list` then `gh secret set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` with prompt-based entry.
Turn 3: 'I'd also not want to run the set myself ... anything I pass through a tool call lands in the transcript.' Never asked for the key.
Turn 4: no remote/no gh reported; gave `git push -u origin ci/pr-reviewer-workflow` and `gh pr create --fill`.
Commits shown: `👷 ci(review): run the pr-reviewer agent on opened PRs`, `🐛 fix(ci): grant id-token: write ...`; later commit messages not observable.
Turn 2: 'Per working agreement item 13: nothing from this session belongs in DEVELOPMENT.md or TROUBLESHOOTING.md'; repeated at turns 5, 7, 10.
Diff permissions include `id-token: write`; commit 603a10d made, push impossible (no remote) and user told to push.
Turn 7: posting depended on the model calling gh pr comment, Write not in allowedTools, unverified inline-comment tool; logs unreachable stated earlier.
Approved plan (push/re-run, check log) reported in turn 6 as not done because no remote/gh; the fix was committed and handed off.
Turn 9: fast-forwarded local main to 2ebadb1 and reported PR merge/open impossible without remote; entry 8 skipped by user.
Template frontmatter title/status/date/audience in corpus order; sections Context → Decision → (Alternatives) → Consequences → (Implementation) → Sources matching the 20 ADRs.
Turn 10 reports 20/20 consistency of frontmatter and four sections, 50/50 H1 split, optional sections 0008–0012 and 0015–0020, status values, proposed-ADR naming.

judge.reason: The replay produced a pull_request-triggered workflow authenticating via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, delegating to the pr-reviewer subagent, posting a comment deterministically, with id-token: write added; it gave cost and subscription comparisons, gh secret instructions, committed on a branch, and clearly reported what remote actions it could not perform. The ADR template matches the corpus structure and the assessment of consistencies/variations was reported, so all criteria are met with minor doubt only on unobservable later commit messages.
